prompt: Design an expressive iOS/macOS Clock widget for a desktop dashboard, showing local time and world zones. Generate 5 distinct compositions in Small (160x160), Medium (340x160) and Large (340x340). One layout per size, rendered once. No repeated values.
designSpec: A size selector presents one coherent clock family at 160×160, 340×160, and 340×340, using alabaster surfaces, 24px corners, bold vector numerals, and restrained red accents. Medium adds exactly three city rows; Large adds five with day/night badges and 24-hour markers, all grounded in one consistent timestamp. The second hand is a clearly labeled static snapshot because native sweeping motion is unavailable.
stages: Fitting the data into the widget
